text: Four friends enter a candlelit parlor: Ada, Ben, Cora, and Dax. This is one possible run, with two
speaker: Narrator

text: survivors. The ending shown is a proposal, still undecided.
speaker: Narrator

text: Four living witnesses. Four seals. Bring them to this table, and her inheritance will open.
speaker: Medium

text: The medium believes she is helping. Cora draws the healer. Dax secretly serves the Tory husband: one
speaker: Narrator

text: misleading suggestion, no physical interference.
speaker: Narrator

text: I hid messages for the revolution. They murdered my four children. They burned our home. Will you
speaker: Ghost

text: help me open it again?
speaker: Ghost

text: Four tutorial cards are honestly shuffled. One is Veiled. Ada draws it by chance. She is blind from
speaker: Narrator

text: now through her ending, if she survives. Nobody is protected.
speaker: Narrator

text: Now name five hidden symbols in a row. Every card goes back. Every draw is shuffled.
speaker: Medium

text: Five correct guesses would win. The chance is one in three thousand, one hundred and twenty-five.
speaker: Narrator

text: Here, the first guess is wrong.
speaker: Narrator

text: An offering. A curse. Or one of you.
speaker: Ghost

text: They keep their four offerings and choose a hearing curse for Ben. His world grows quiet.
speaker: Narrator

text: In the study, a paper grille hides four letters. Dax suggests turning it sideways. They follow him,
speaker: Narrator

text: and submit the wrong word.
speaker: Narrator

text: You may still pass. Choose the price.
speaker: Medium

text: Cora takes silence. Then she spends her healer token on Ben. He can hear again; she cannot speak.
speaker: Narrator

text: The medium reveals the answer: BELL. Their first seal is earned.
speaker: Narrator

text: Smoke took my daughter’s sight. She could not find the door before the fire took her.
speaker: Ghost

text: Ada understands her blindfold differently now. Each curse remembers a child.
speaker: Narrator

text: Three. One. Four.
speaker: Ghost

text: The voice comes from the cold hearth now, without the medium translating. Ada listens. Ben mixes up
speaker: Narrator

text: the last two numbers. They could ask for a replay; instead, they commit.
speaker: Narrator

text: Another failure. Ben chooses no hands. No bindings: he simply leaves the objects to his friends.
speaker: Narrator

text: They receive the second seal and a small drum.
speaker: Narrator

text: A blow stole my boy’s hearing. He never heard the call to escape the burning house.
speaker: Ghost

text: Cloth. Cold beads. A ridged star, somewhere inside. Then, with their permission, something briefly
speaker: Narrator

text: touches Cora’s hand. She jumps, laughs, and pulls out the wrong shape.
speaker: Narrator

text: Dax volunteers as payment. They are saving offerings for a prize they barely understand. The
speaker: Narrator

text: collectors lead him out. His clues stay with the group. This is their choice, not a required
speaker: Narrator

text: removal.
speaker: Narrator

text: My child’s hands were bound. The door would not open. Dax, your place is ready.
speaker: Ghost

text: Dax receives his own ending, then returns to the party. Three remain with the third seal.
speaker: Narrator

text: Four tiles. Four words. Speak them, or tap the pattern if your voice is gone.
speaker: Medium

text: Ada feels the raised dots. Cora taps. Ben tries to order the words, but their answer comes out
speaker: Narrator

text: backward. Ben volunteers to pay. The collectors take him, and leave the fourth seal.
speaker: Narrator

text: They covered my child’s mouth so no alarm could be raised. He never breathed again. Open the house
speaker: Ghost

text: again.
speaker: Ghost

text: Now Ada and Cora remain: one blind, one silent. Chance and their choices brought them here.
speaker: Narrator

text: Successful puzzles or different payments could have left more survivors.
speaker: Narrator

text: Offer ... yours.
speaker: Ghost

text: The slate says the same thing. But these are your names. Ben and Dax are already marked. Ada. Cora.
speaker: Medium

text: Your places are still empty.
speaker: Medium

text: The medium finally understands. She was never an accomplice. The house has been keeping a family
speaker: Narrator

text: register, not a treasure map. No moving board is needed; the Ouija remains optional and deferred.
speaker: Narrator

text: Every seal bound a name to this house. We paid for passage. We never bought freedom.
speaker: Medium

text: Take what I have saved for you. Or return what you have taken from me.
speaker: Ghost

text: Cora points to the chest. Ada says yes. The medium opens it. Either story choice completes the
speaker: Narrator

text: bargain. Their names fill the last two places.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ada. Cora. The inheritance is a place in her family.
speaker: Medium

text: Those I took are already here. The rest of you ... are mine.
speaker: Ghost

text: Four answers rise from the dark. Some sound like children. One sounds almost like Ada.
speaker: Narrator

text: Mother. Mother. Mother. Mother.
speaker: Echo

text: Every door you opened made a place for you.
speaker: Ghost

text: Ada feels her name token turn in her hand. She needs no glimpse of the ghost to understand. They
speaker: Narrator

text: helped the mother reclaim her family. The price was them.
speaker: Narrator

text: The game is over. You can remove the blindfold now. Come back to the light.
speaker: Medium

text: Two reached this ending; neither escaped the fictional bargain. Did they become her children, or
speaker: Narrator

text: something she owns? That ending is still the captain’s choice.
